newsitem.title: UK: UK retail sales rise 0.7 pct in Nov.
newsitem.headline: UK retail sales rise 0.7 pct in Nov.

text.p: The Office for National Statistics (ONS) released the following seasonally adjusted data on UK retail sales in November.
RETAIL SALES VOLUME NOV OCT (OCT PREL)
Market forecasts had centred on a 0.5 percent rise in retail sales on the month and a year-on-year increase of 4.1 percent.
BY SECTOR (percentage gain, minus indicates fall)
The average weekly non-seasonally adjusted value of retail sales in November was 3.6 billion stg, 8.1 percent up on November 1995.
In value terms, retail sales rose by seven percent in the three months to end November on the same period a year earlier.
The ONS said the November trading period has shifted in relation to last due to the five-week trading period in January. It said allowances have been made for in the seasonally adjusted series.
